stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one

on the last line of your reply:

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

import os,re,collections,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); inp=G['Demo pair 1 input']; out=G['Demo pair 1 output']
gi=G['Demo pair 2 input']; go=G['Demo pair 2 output']
T=G['Test input']
def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    # extract the key line structure: most common run direction among all colors
    V=sum(1 for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if i+1<H and g[i][j]!=0 and g[i+1][j]==g[i][j])
    H_=sum(1 for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if j+1<W and g[i][j]!=0 and g[i][j+1]==g[i][j])
    A=sum(1 for i in range(H) for j in range(1,W) if i+1<H and g[i][j]!=0 and g[i+1][j-1]==g[i][j])
    D_=sum(1 for i in range(H) for j in range(W-1) if i+1<H and g[i][j]!=0 and g[i+1][j+1]==g[i][j])
    if A>=D_: key=lambda p:(p[0]+p[1]); steps=[(-1,1),(1,-1)]
    elif V>H_: key=lambda p:p[0]; steps=[(1,0),(-1,0)]
    else: key=lambda p:p[1]; steps=[(0,1),(0,-1)]
    mn=min(key(p) for p in [(a,b) for a in range(H) for b in range(W) if g[a][b]])
    mx=max(key(p) for p in [(a,b) for a in range(H) for b in range(W) if g[a][b]])
    n=mx-mn+1
    seq=[]
    for k in sorted(range(mn,mx+1)):
        found=None
        for (a,b) in [(a,b) for a in range(H) for b in range(W) if g[a][b] and key((a,b))==k]:
            found=g[a][b]; break
        seq.append(found if found is not None else None)
    seq=[v for v in seq if v is not None]
    # cyclic right rotation by 2 (verified on demo 2; consistent with demo 1 pattern)
    if len(seq)>1: seq=seq[-2:]+seq[:-2]
    res=[]
    for a in range(H):
        row=[]
        for b in range(W):
            row.append(seq[(key((a,b))-mn)%n])
        res.append(row)
    return res
print('d1:',f(inp)==out,'d2:',f(gi)==go)
print(json.dumps(f(T)))
